_source: assets/characters/enemy/Pro Magic Pack with final boss.zip
rootCurveSpace: [forward, right] metres relative to clip start

unused.Standing Walk/Run Left/Right variants be: run_left/right, sprint: the boss repositions by walking or teleporting
unused.Standing Jump Running (+ Landing), Stand: no running jumps in a one-room fight
unused.Standing React Small From Back/Left/Righ: two flinch + two stagger clips cover it

idle_taunt.note: long idle with a hand flourish (4.8 s): phase-change taunt

throw.note: wind-up, right hand flings forward (0.80): single bolt

sweep.note: right arm sweeps across (0.53): cone / fan

double_cast.note: two gestures: down (0.33), up (0.93): twin bolts

raise.note: right hand raised overhead (0.60): call down / summon

slam_call.note: hands up, crouch-slam (0.63), arms raised (1.33): bombardment

ground_slam.note: arms up then both hands to the floor (1.27): ground wave

nova.note: gather, arms flung wide (1.80): radial burst

beam.note: two-hand thrust at 1.00 held to ~2.9 s: channelled beam

charge_orb.note: hands together (0.90) then release (2.0): charged orb

crouch_blast.note: deep crouch gather (0.67), rise and fling (2.03): point-blank burst

kneel.note: sinks to one knee: phase break
